eforsyning.title: E|Forsyning login ({utility_name})
eforsyning.description:
Status: {status_badge}

⚠️ Experimental: E|Forsyning support has been verified live at Sorø Fjernvarme; other E|Forsyning utilities await a first test — beta testers wanted.

Log in with the **forbrugernummer** (consumer number) and **webpinkode** (web PIN) from your heating bill (same as on {portal_url}). No MitID is used. The credentials are stored in Home Assistant like other integrations' passwords, never logged and redacted in diagnostics.

**Portal URL, slug, or supplier id** (only for 'Other E|Forsyning utility'): paste your utility's portal URL (e.g. {example_url}), just the slug (`horsens`), or the supplier UUID — the rest is resolved automatically without F12.

wattson.title: Watts On login ({utility_name})
wattson.description:
Status: {status_badge}

⚠️ Experimental and unofficial: Watts On support has been verified live at Aalborg Forsyning; other Watts On utilities await a first test — beta testers wanted. It uses the same API as the Watts On app and may break if Watts changes it.

Your heat meter must already be added in the Watts On app. Do this on a **computer** (not the phone with the Watts app):

1. **[Open the Watts On login]({auth_url})** and sign in with your Watts On account (same e-mail and password as in the app). Home Assistant never sees your password.
2. At the end the browser tries to open an address starting with `msauth://com.seasnve.watts/…`. It cannot — the page stalls or shows an error. That is expected.
3. Copy that address: **Chrome/Edge:** press F12 → *Console* tab → the line *Failed to launch 'msauth://…'* → copy the whole line (or F12 → *Network* → last request → *Location*). **Firefox:** the address is shown in the address bar/error page.
4. Paste it here within about 10 minutes (the code works only once). After an error a new login link is created automatically.

Home Assistant only stores a *refresh token* (like other integrations store passwords). It is renewed on every sync, never logged and redacted in diagnostics.

data.wattson_refresh_token: Advanced: refresh token (instead of the address)

data_description.wattson_redirect_url: The whole address (or the whole console line) — it contains code=…
data_description.wattson_refresh_token: Only if you already have a token, e.g. from tools/login.py in Novafos-V2. Leave empty otherwise.

wattson_device.title: Choose heat meter
wattson_device.description: The Watts On account has several meters, or the heat meter could not be recognised with certainty. Pick the meter for your district heating.

error.invalid_auth: E|Forsyning rejected the consumer number / web PIN.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to E|Forsyning (check the supplier id and network).
error.eforsyning_missing: Enter both consumer number and web PIN.
error.eforsyning_supplier_required: The supplier id or portal URL is required for this utility.
error.eforsyning_supplier_lookup_failed: Could not resolve a valid supplier id from that URL/slug. Check the portal address (e.g. eforsyning.dk/horsens) or paste the supplier UUID directly.
error.eforsyning_directory_failed: Could not fetch the utility list from eforsyning.dk — enter the utility URL, slug, or supplier id instead.
error.wattson_missing: Paste the address starting with msauth:// (or a refresh token).
error.wattson_no_code: No code= found in what you pasted. Copy the whole msauth:// address and retry with the new login link.
error.wattson_state_mismatch: That address belongs to an older login link. Use the new link above and retry.
error.wattson_login_cancelled: The login was cancelled or refused by Watts On. Retry with the new link.
error.wattson_code_rejected: Watts On rejected the code (expired or already used). Use the new link and paste the address right away.
error.wattson_token_rejected: Watts On rejected this refresh token.
error.wattson_cannot_connect: Could not connect to Watts On. Try again later.
error.wattson_no_heat_meter: The Watts On account has no heat meter (only water/electricity). Add your heat meter in the Watts On app first.
error.wattson_wrong_account: This is a different Watts On account than the one this entry was set up with.

init.title: Dansk Fjernvarme — Settings

data.bonus_temp: Expected return / bonus threshold (°C, 0 = from E|Forsyning / default)
data.penalty_temp: Return temp penalty threshold (°C, 0 = same as expected / default)
data.forward_temp: Supply/forward temperature override (°C, 0 = automatic from meter)
data.price_dkk_per_kwh: Heat price incl. VAT (DKK/kWh, 0 = published default)
data.motivation_pct_per_k: Motivation tariff in percent (% per °C, e.g. 1, 0 = default)
data.fixed_fee_dkk_per_m2_year: Annual area / subscription fee incl. VAT (DKK/m²/year, 0 = published default)
data.fixed_fee_dkk_per_year: Flat annual subscription / meter fee incl. VAT (DKK/year, optional, 0 = none)
data.sync_reminder: Soft weekend reminder (shown Sat/Sun if not synced Thu–Sat)
data.wattson_energy_unit: Watts On: energy unit (auto = meter metadata/heuristic)
data.wattson_endpoint: Watts On: advanced endpoint template (empty = automatic, e.g. heating/api/consumptions/DEVICE_ID)

init.description: Outdoor temperature (graddage/HDD17, kWh per degree day, temperature lines): an optional Home Assistant outdoor sensor is used first (local, from the recorder's long-term statistics). Days without sensor statistics use Open-Meteo (external weather service) at your Home Assistant home location, or at the coordinates below if you fill them in.

data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Your own outdoor thermometer (temperature sensor with long-term statistics, state_class measurement). Daily means are read locally from the recorder. Days from before the sensor existed fall back to Open-Meteo. Leave empty to use Open-Meteo only.
data_description.latitude: Leave empty to use the Home Assistant home location (Settings → System → General). Only fill in to use another place for Open-Meteo. The utility's location is only used if Home Assistant has no home location.
data_description.longitude: Fill in together with latitude, or leave both empty.
data_description.kmd_supply: If Min Forsyning has several customer relationships (e.g. electricity and district heating + water), choose Heat (Varme). The list appears after the first sync. Electricity (E17) is never selected automatically.

error.location_incomplete: Fill in both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty to use the Home Assistant home location.
